newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DERBY CHASING MONACO DEFENDER PETIT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DERBY CHASING MONACO DEFENDER PETIT.

text.p: Monaco have received a reported three million pounds ($4.9 million) offer from English side Derby County for versatile defender Emmanuel Petit.
But a club official said on Friday that Monaco would make no statement until Sunday on any of the offers they have received for players.
Petit has expressed a keen interest in a move abroad and preferably to England.
Club president Jean-Louis Campora has said Monaco do not want to release Petit, who is under contract to Monaco for another two seasons.
